title: Keys Derive-and-Sign — payload
description: Derive a key at a path and sign with it in one step, without adding a stored key record.

keyType.description: Algorithm to derive. MUST be one that can sign.

derivationPath.description: Hierarchical-deterministic path to derive at. The same path against the same seed always yields the same key, which is what makes this reproducible rather than ephemeral.

payload.description: The exact bytes to sign, base64url-encoded without padding. Signed verbatim — not parsed, canonicalized or wrapped.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. MUST be compatible with the derived key's type.

Response.title: Keys Derive-and-Sign — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a keys/derive-and-sign request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/keys/derive-and-sign/0.1#response.

publicKey.description: Public half of the derived key, multibase-encoded — so the producer learns the identity it just signed as, which it could not otherwise know for a key that was never stored.
